## Summary

Describe the user-visible or operational change.

## Verification

List the exact commands, platform checks, and any device evidence.

## Risks

Describe daemon lifecycle, protocol, plugin, persistence, privacy, and release risks that apply.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests assert observable behavior.
- [ ] Operator, plugin-author, or release documentation is updated when its contract changes.
- [ ] Generated files and release inputs match their canonical sources.
- [ ] No credential, device identifier, calendar detail, or Codex session content is present.
- [ ] The pull request title is a valid Conventional Commit.
